name: dotgain
description: Dotgain by Coldset Works: all-or-nothing crowdfunding for small-press print runs

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/client/tsconfig.json && esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/public/app.js && esbuild src/client/styles.css --bundle --minify --external:/assets/* --outfile=dist/public/app.css
